title: Somalia — Emergency Trend Tracking Dataset (since June 2026)
notes: Official public dataset page; downloadable source file has not yet been ingested. The Week 19 report states that data collection paused from 1–16 October 2026 and resumed on 17 October with in-person interviews in 16 districts. The series therefore has a material collection gap and a methodology/coverage transition; do not interpolate missing weeks or interpret the break as zero displacement. Methodological limitations from the official Q2 2026 report: findings are estimates from remote and in-person key-informant interviews; most indicators describe the majority of displaced people at a location rather than every person; detailed origins are not fully collected/reported; districts cover main urban centres and surrounding areas rather than full district populations; GPS coordinates may be approximate. Treat origin and cause breakdowns as reported majority estimates, not exhaustive person-level records.
